offering_description.value: Operates a portfolio of digital media brands in technology, gaming and health, earning revenue from advertising and subscriptions. Also sells internet performance testing, cybersecurity and digital marketing software to businesses and consumers.

primary_products.value: online content; internet speed testing software; cybersecurity software; marketing software

primary_services.value: digital advertising; lead generation; performance marketing; cybersecurity services

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, agencies, and businesses buying security and marketing software; B2C: readers, online shoppers, and consumers using speed tests and subscriptions

end_markets.value: technology; gaming; health; telecommunications; advertising and marketing; cybersecurity

revenue_model.value: advertising: display and video ads sold to brands and agencies on websites; subscription: paid software and online subscriptions; commissions or management fees: affiliate commissions on products recommended in reviews
revenue_model.category: advertising; subscription; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and runs consumer media brands, selling audiences to advertisers; software / platform: builds security and performance testing software sold to businesses and consumers; service provider: provides digital marketing and lead generation services to advertisers
value_chain_position.category: brand owner; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Readers and customers across North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: diversified: digital media brands, internet performance testing, cybersecurity, and digital marketing software

distribution_channels.value: online: websites, apps, and newsletters reaching readers directly; direct sales: advertising sales teams selling to brands and agencies; partners / resellers: channel partners reselling security and marketing software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and advertising rules, such as GDPR and CCPA, plus consumer protection laws
